This installer has not yet run on any device. Every device step is unverified until lab test Q-INST-06 is certified.
This adds 'set system services netconf ssh': NETCONF over SSH on TCP 830 and on the SSH port, reachable on fxp0 and on any interface whose security zone admits netconf (830) or ssh (22), not only J-Wicket's loopback session.
Check that your CLI prompt shows labadmin@<the lab device you intend> before unit A.
Unit A (device-configuration): bootstrap: open configuration mode
Status: 'run' verified; '| no-more' inferred
```
configure exclusive
run show system commit | no-more
```
STOP if the newest entry (0) ends with 'commit confirmed, rollback in <n>mins' (a commit confirmed is waiting) or the output starts with 'commit requested by' (a pending 'commit at'); Juniper's sample wording, unverified on 24.4 (Q-INST-01): type 'exit'. Otherwise paste unit B.

Unit B (device-configuration): bootstrap: the configuration change
Status: statements documented (Spec 006 section 7.3); unverified on a device
```
set system services netconf ssh
show | compare | no-more
```
STOP unless 'show | compare' shows the same statements and nothing else. This rendering does not know which levels the device already has: Junos prints each change under the deepest level that already exists, and a new level (for example a new 'file jwicket.py' entry) as a braced block of '+' lines under that header, so the same statements may appear grouped that way rather than one leaf per header (illustrative; real samples are recorded by lab test Q-INST-01). For example:
    [edit system services netconf]
    +    ssh;
If it shows anything else, type 'rollback 0' and 'exit'.

Unit C (device-configuration): bootstrap: commit confirmed (not confirmed by you)
Status: inferred to combine minutes and comment
```
commit confirmed 10 comment "jwicket-bootstrap netconf k3v9qt"
```
Deadline: 10 minutes. The installer confirms this commit only after its own checks and your typed host name; otherwise Junos removes it.

Unit D (device-configuration): bootstrap: leave configuration mode
```
exit
```
Keep this CLI session open until the installer reports that it confirmed the bootstrap: whether closing a CLI session rolls back its pending 'commit confirmed' early is unknown (lab test Q-INST-03). Do not type 'commit' to confirm it yourself: the installer confirms it only after its own checks and your typed host name. If you stop here, Junos removes it at its deadline.

Unit E (workstation): then, within the deadline
```
jwicket-install install --apply --release v0.1.0.dev1 --host <device> --user labadmin --bootstrap-nonce k3v9qt
```
